issues.extracted: Other state receipts 7,845 (intergovernmental/state aid), split_from 'Sales and other taxes 122,972'
issues.on_page: p4 Sales and other taxes: General 102,069, Street 20,903 (total 122,972); p8 all-funds budget schedule: Sales tax 94,224, Motor vehicle tax 20,903, Other state receipts 7,845
issues.issue: No page prints a breakdown of 'Sales and other taxes' itself. The pieces come from matching all-funds budget-schedule lines (94,224 + 20,903 + 7,845 = 122,972 exactly), and the 7,845 piece is the General Fund remainder (102,069 - 94,224). The arithmetic is exact and the match is plausible because State shared receipts 337,164 = Equalization 166,908 + Highway 170,256. Still, it is an inference, and a state-aid piece is being placed inside a tax line. Same for detail[2].

issues.on_page: Operating revenues: Charges for services: Other 7,911
issues.issue: The proprietary statement (p6) prints this 'Other' under the 'Charges for services' heading, but the Statement of Activities (p2) counts it in Miscellaneous. It is defensible as other, but the two pages conflict. The same applies to detail Other lines for Water 7,000, Electric 697 and Trash 214.
It is printed under General government, but the disbursement rules put TIF in economic development. Judgment call. Same for detail[14].

This is a non-cash amortization (probably of the deferred loss/gain on bond refunding shown on p1/p5), so other is a last resort. It could instead go with debt service or a new 'Amortization' category. Same for detail[29] (Water 820) and detail[48] (Electric 1,304).
